Papier.name: labels
Papier.doc: Override built-in strings, e.g. `englishLabels` or a partial set.

Papier.name: motion
Papier.doc: `reduced` makes every Papier transition instant, independent of the OS setting.

Papier.name: theme
Papier.doc: Colour theme for everything inside. `system` follows the OS setting.

Text.name: as
Text.doc: Element to render; defaults to a sensible tag per variant.

Text.name: variant
Text.doc: Typographic role from the Papier scale.

Button.name: asChild
Button.doc: Render the single child element (e.g. a router link) with the button's look and behaviour instead of a <button>. Its children become the label.

Button.name: loading
Button.doc: Shows a spinner and blocks activation while keeping the button focusable.

IconButton.name: label
IconButton.doc: Accessible name; required because the button only shows an icon.

IconButton.name: asChild
IconButton.doc: Render this element (e.g. a router link) instead of a <button>; it shows the icon.

IconButton.name: children
IconButton.doc: Only with `asChild`: the element to render.

IconButton.name: variant
IconButton.doc: `disc` is the portfolio's ink circle that turns vermilion on hover.

Link.name: asChild
Link.doc: Render the single child element (e.g. Next.js or React Router `Link`) with Papier's link style.

Link.name: external
Link.doc: Opens in a new tab with safe rel and an announced hint.

Link.name: variant
Link.doc: `underline`: a resting line that darkens on hover. `quiet`: the line rises only on hover. `arrow`: label with a thin arrow that nudges up-right.

Surface.name: elevation
Surface.doc: `object` adds the portfolio's tactile shadow with light top and dark bottom edge. Prose stays flat.

Surface.name: material
Surface.doc: The material of the module. Text colour follows it automatically.

Notice.name: action
Notice.doc: A recovery or follow-up action, e.g. a Button.

Notice.name: icon
Notice.doc: Replaces the tone's mark, e.g. a Spinner while something is still running. Decorative.

Notice.name: live
Notice.doc: Announce changes: `polite` for results, `assertive` only for errors that block. Default depends on tone.

Progress.name: label
Progress.doc: Visible label; also the accessible name.

Progress.name: valueText
Progress.doc: Text shown next to the label, e.g. "3 van 5". Defaults to a percentage.

Field.name: children
Field.doc: The control: a render function that gets the props, or elements that call useFieldControl().

Field.name: describedBy
Field.doc: Extra ids for the control's aria-describedby.

Field.name: error
Field.doc: Error text. Sets aria-invalid and is announced with the field.

Field.name: hideLabel
Field.doc: Visually hides the label while keeping it as the accessible name.

Field.name: required
Field.doc: Shows the asterisk; set `required` on the control as well.

FieldLabel.name: required
FieldLabel.doc: Adds a decorative asterisk; mark the control itself as required too.

FieldLabel.name: visuallyHidden
FieldLabel.doc: Visually hides the label while keeping it as the accessible name.

TextField.name: error
TextField.doc: Error text. Sets aria-invalid and is announced with the field.

TextField.name: hideLabel
TextField.doc: Visually hides the label while keeping it as the accessible name.

TextField.name: prefix
TextField.doc: Before the value: an icon or a unit such as €. Decorative, so name the unit in the label or hint too.

TextField.name: suffix
TextField.doc: After the value: an icon or a unit such as kg. Decorative, so name the unit in the label or hint too.

TextArea.name: autoResize
TextArea.doc: Grows with its content instead of scrolling, from `rows` up to `maxRows`.

TextArea.name: error
TextArea.doc: Error text. Sets aria-invalid and is announced with the field.

TextArea.name: hideLabel
TextArea.doc: Visually hides the label while keeping it as the accessible name.

TextArea.name: maxRows
TextArea.doc: With autoResize: the height at which it stops growing and scrolls.

Checkbox.name: error
Checkbox.doc: Error text, e.g. for terms that must be accepted. Sets aria-invalid.

Checkbox.name: indeterminate
Checkbox.doc: Partly checked, e.g. "select all" when some rows are selected. Announced as "mixed".

CheckboxGroup.name: appearance
CheckboxGroup.doc: `card` gives each option a bordered tile.

CheckboxGroup.name: name
CheckboxGroup.doc: Form name; every checked option is submitted under it.

CheckboxGroup.name: value
CheckboxGroup.doc: The checked values, in the order of `options`.

Slider.name: formatValue
Slider.doc: Formats the visible value and aria-valuetext, e.g. seconds as 1:24.

Tabs.name: activation
Tabs.doc: `manual`: arrows only move focus and Enter or Space opens the tab. Use it when a panel is slow to load.

Tabs.name: orientation
Tabs.doc: `vertical` puts the tabs in a column beside the panel (above it on small screens) and uses the up and down arrows.

Accordion.name: type
Accordion.doc: `single`: opening one section folds the open one. `multiple`: each opens on its own.

Dialog.name: onClose
Dialog.doc: Called for Escape, the close button and (by default) a backdrop click.

Dialog.name: footer
Dialog.doc: Actions, e.g. Cancel and Confirm buttons.

Dialog.name: returnFocusTo
Dialog.doc: Where focus goes after closing. Defaults to the element that opened it.

RadioGroup.name: appearance
RadioGroup.doc: `card` gives each option a bordered tile, handy for plans or modes.

Tooltip.name: children
Tooltip.doc: One focusable element, e.g. an IconButton. Its own ref keeps working.

Tooltip.name: content
Tooltip.doc: Extra description. Never the only name: an icon button still needs its own label.

Tooltip.name: delay
Tooltip.doc: Hover delay in ms; keyboard focus shows it immediately.

Tooltip.name: placement
Tooltip.doc: Preferred side; flips to the opposite side when there is no room.

Menu.name: items
Menu.doc: Items, with `{ type: 'separator' }` and `{ type: 'label', label }` to group them.

Menu.name: side
Menu.doc: Preferred side of the trigger; flips when there is no room.

Menu.name: triggerLabel
Menu.doc: Accessible name when the trigger is only an icon.

Table.name: caption
Table.doc: Required: names the table for screen readers and the scroll region.

Table.name: showCaption
Table.doc: Show the caption visually as well.

Skeleton.name: lines
Skeleton.doc: Number of text lines; the last one is shorter.

Sheet.name: hideTitle
Sheet.doc: Visually hide the title (it stays the accessible name), e.g. for a navigation sheet.

Sheet.name: returnFocusTo
Sheet.doc: Where focus goes after closing. Defaults to the element that opened it.

Stack.name: gap
Stack.doc: Gap as a step of the Papier space scale (4 to 72 px).

Container.name: size
Container.doc: sm 720, md 1040, lg 1300 (the portfolio field), full.

Avatar.name: name
Avatar.doc: The person's or artist's name: used as alt text and for the initials fallback.

Avatar.name: decorative
Avatar.doc: Set when the name is already written next to the avatar, to avoid saying it twice.

AlertDialog.name: confirmLabel
AlertDialog.doc: A verb for the action, e.g. "Verwijderen". Never "OK" or "Ja".

AlertDialog.name: onClose
AlertDialog.doc: Called for Escape, Cancel and after a successful confirm.

AlertDialog.name: onConfirm
AlertDialog.doc: The action. Return a promise to keep the dialog open with a loading button until it settles: it closes when the promise resolves and stays open when it rejects.

AlertDialog.name: title
AlertDialog.doc: A question that names the consequence, e.g. "Plaat uit je collectie halen?".

AlertDialog.name: returnFocusTo
AlertDialog.doc: Where focus goes after closing. Defaults to the element that opened it.

AlertDialog.name: tone
AlertDialog.doc: `danger` for actions that delete or cannot be undone.

Combobox.name: emptyText
Combobox.doc: Shown when nothing matches; defaults to the "no results" label.

Combobox.name: filter
Combobox.doc: How typed text matches an option. `false` shows `options` as given (already filtered).

Combobox.name: inputValue
Combobox.doc: The typed text, for searching on a server. Use with `filter={false}`.

Combobox.name: loading
Combobox.doc: Shows a loading line in the list, e.g. while a server search runs.

Combobox.name: onChange
Combobox.type: (value: string | null, option: ComboboxOption | null) => void

Combobox.name: value
Combobox.doc: The chosen option's value, or null for none.

Breadcrumb.name: label
Breadcrumb.doc: Name of the landmark; defaults to the "breadcrumb" label.

BreadcrumbItem.name: asChild
BreadcrumbItem.doc: Render the single child (e.g. Next.js or React Router `Link`) as the item's link.

BreadcrumbItem.name: current
BreadcrumbItem.doc: The page you are on. An item without href or asChild is the current page too.

Pagination.name: getHref
Pagination.doc: Makes every page a real link, so it can be opened in a new tab and crawled.

Pagination.name: label
Pagination.doc: Name of the landmark; defaults to the "pagination" label.

Pagination.name: linkAs
Pagination.doc: Component for those links, e.g. Next.js `Link`. It gets href, className, aria-* and children.

Pagination.name: onPageChange
Pagination.doc: Called with the chosen page. Without getHref the pages are buttons.

Pagination.name: siblings
Pagination.doc: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

Popover.name: children
Popover.doc: Content, or a function that gets `close` for a button that applies and closes.

Popover.name: trigger
Popover.doc: One element that opens the popover, e.g. a Button. Its own onClick keeps working.

Popover.name: closeButton
Popover.doc: Shows a close button in the corner. Escape and a click outside always close.

Popover.name: initialFocus
Popover.doc: Element that gets focus on open. Defaults to the first control in the panel.

Popover.name: label
Popover.doc: Accessible name when there is no visible title.

Popover.name: side
Popover.doc: Preferred side of the trigger; flips when there is no room.

Popover.name: title
Popover.doc: Visible heading; also the accessible name of the panel.

NumberField.name: formatOptions
NumberField.doc: Intl.NumberFormat options, e.g. `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }` or `{ style: 'percent' }`.

NumberField.name: hideStepper
NumberField.doc: Hides the − and + buttons; the arrow keys still step.

NumberField.name: locale
NumberField.doc: Locale for formatting and parsing. Defaults to the `locale` of the Papier labels.

NumberField.name: prefix
NumberField.doc: Before the value: an icon or unit. Decorative, so name the unit in the label or hint too.

NumberField.name: step
NumberField.doc: Step for the buttons and arrow keys; PageUp and PageDown take ten steps.

NumberField.name: suffix
NumberField.doc: After the value: an icon or unit. Decorative, so name the unit in the label or hint too.

NumberField.name: value
NumberField.doc: The number, or null when the field is empty.

PasswordField.name: visible
PasswordField.doc: Whether the password shows as text.

FileField.name: accept
FileField.doc: Allowed types, as for the native input: ".jpg,.png", "image/*" or "application/pdf".

FileField.name: dropText
FileField.doc: Text in the drop zone; defaults to the "choose files" label.

FileField.name: onReject
FileField.doc: Called with files that were refused, and why. They are also announced in the field.

Toggle.name: icon
Toggle.doc: Shown before the label; when pressed without one, a tick appears so state is never colour alone.

ToggleGroup.name: value
ToggleGroup.doc: The pressed values, in the order of `options`.

SortHeader.name: onSort
SortHeader.doc: Called when the header is activated; decide the next direction yourself or use useTableSort.

SortHeader.name: align
SortHeader.doc: `end` for number columns, so the header lines up with `pp-num` cells.

SortHeader.name: sort
SortHeader.doc: This column's sort direction, or none when another column (or nothing) is sorted.

MultiCombobox.name: emptyText
MultiCombobox.doc: Shown when nothing matches; defaults to the "no results" label.

MultiCombobox.name: filter
MultiCombobox.doc: How typed text matches an option. `false` shows `options` as given (already filtered).

MultiCombobox.name: inputValue
MultiCombobox.doc: The typed search text, for searching on a server. Use with `filter={false}`.

MultiCombobox.name: max
MultiCombobox.doc: Most items that can be chosen; further options are disabled until one is removed.

MultiCombobox.name: value
MultiCombobox.doc: The chosen values, in the order they were chosen.

RangeSlider.name: formatValue
RangeSlider.doc: Formats the visible values and each thumb's aria-valuetext.

RangeSlider.name: marks
RangeSlider.doc: Ticks under the track, optionally with a label, e.g. `[{ value: 1960, label: '1960' }]`.

RangeSlider.name: minDistance
RangeSlider.doc: Smallest gap between the two thumbs.

RangeSlider.name: name
RangeSlider.doc: Form name; both values are submitted under it, low first.

RangeSlider.name: onValueCommit
RangeSlider.doc: Called when a thumb is let go or a key is released, e.g. to start a search only then.

Calendar.name: autoFocus
Calendar.doc: Moves focus to the active day when the calendar appears, e.g. inside a popover.

Calendar.name: defaultMonth
Calendar.doc: A date in the month shown first; defaults to the value or today.

Calendar.name: isDateUnavailable
Calendar.doc: Dates that cannot be chosen, e.g. days a shop is closed.

Calendar.name: locale
Calendar.doc: Locale for names and the first day of the week. Defaults to the `locale` of the Papier labels.

Calendar.name: max
Calendar.doc: Latest date that can be chosen, "YYYY-MM-DD".

Calendar.name: min
Calendar.doc: Earliest date that can be chosen, "YYYY-MM-DD".

Calendar.name: value
Calendar.doc: The chosen date as "YYYY-MM-DD", or null.

RangeCalendar.name: autoFocus
RangeCalendar.doc: Moves focus to the active day when the calendar appears, e.g. inside a popover.

RangeCalendar.name: defaultMonth
RangeCalendar.doc: A date in the month shown first; defaults to the value or today.

RangeCalendar.name: isDateUnavailable
RangeCalendar.doc: Dates that cannot be chosen, e.g. days a shop is closed.

RangeCalendar.name: locale
RangeCalendar.doc: Locale for names and the first day of the week. Defaults to the `locale` of the Papier labels.

RangeCalendar.name: max
RangeCalendar.doc: Latest date that can be chosen, "YYYY-MM-DD".

RangeCalendar.name: min
RangeCalendar.doc: Earliest date that can be chosen, "YYYY-MM-DD".

RangeCalendar.name: onValueChange
RangeCalendar.doc: Called after the first day (with `end: null`) and again after the second.

DatePicker.name: error
DatePicker.doc: Error text from your own validation. A typed date that does not exist gets its own message.

DatePicker.name: locale
DatePicker.doc: Locale for typing, formatting and the calendar. Defaults to the `locale` of the Papier labels.

DatePicker.name: value
DatePicker.doc: The date as "YYYY-MM-DD", like <input type="date">, or null when empty.

DateRangePicker.name: error
DateRangePicker.doc: Error text from your own validation. Typed dates that do not exist get their own message.

DateRangePicker.name: locale
DateRangePicker.doc: Locale for typing, formatting and the calendar. Defaults to the `locale` of the Papier labels.

DateRangePicker.name: startName
DateRangePicker.doc: Form names for the start and end date.

DateRangePicker.name: value
DateRangePicker.doc: The span as "YYYY-MM-DD" dates; `end` is null while only the start is known.

Separator.name: decorative
Separator.doc: Purely visual: hidden from screen readers. Defaults to true; set false between real sections.

Separator.name: label
Separator.doc: A word in the middle of a horizontal line, e.g. "of" between two ways to sign in. It is read out.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.doc: What is missing, e.g. "Nog geen platen".

EmptyState.name: action
EmptyState.doc: The way forward, e.g. a Button.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.doc: Why, and what to do about it.

EmptyState.name: headingLevel
EmptyState.doc: Level of the title, to fit the page outline.

EmptyState.name: icon
EmptyState.doc: An icon or small illustration. Decorative.
